input_ref: Pharmacy advocate: what is the insulin copay cap on a PDP

output.reason: None of the approved units gives the insulin copay cap for a PDP. U-RX-EDU-001-07 covers not sharing coverage details with unverified callers. U-RX-EDU-001-10 covers saying an estimate reflects the plan copay. U-RX-EDU-001-11 covers not promising the pharmacy charge. None states a cap amount or how a cap applies to insulin.
